description: Áreas ardidas (desde 1975) is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Instituto da Conservação da Natureza e das Florestas, I. P - ICNF. The Instituto da Conservação da Natureza e das Florestas (Institute for Nature Conservation and Forests) publishes the national cartography of burnt areas from 1975 to the present date in accordance with the provisions of Article 2.º(5) of Decree-Law No º 124/2006 of 28 June 2006, as amended by Decree-Law No º 17/2009 of 14 January ... Coverage: Instituto da Conservação da Natureza e das Florestas, I. P - ICNF. The portal shows the English title as "Burnt areas (since 1975)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Instituto da Conservação da Natureza e das Florestas, I. P - ICNF. Its keywords include zonas-de-risco-natural, icnf, nacional, ambiente, infofeatureaccessservice, snig-dgterritorio-gov-pt. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
